request.deadline: Events scheduled for July 28-31, 2026 in Las Vegas, with Dev Gov Day on July 28, 2026 at ARIA Las Vegas.
deliverables: Rare Evo 2026 Cardano title sponsorship for main stage and livestream with media sponsorship
Free GA admission for Cardano community
Complimentary booth space for selected Cardano ecosystem startup projects
Five Cardano main stage panelist positions
Travel and lodging support for 20 community members
10 ARIA hotel room giveaways and 50 VIP ticket giveaways
20% of all VIP ticket sales returned to the Cardano Treasury
Dev Gov Day 2027 venue deposit plus legal, admin, audit, fees, and taxes
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to make Cardano the title sponsor of Rare Evo 2026 main stage/global livestream and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026.

claims.claim: Rare Network requests ₳2,750,000, described as $660,000 at a $0.24 ADA valuation, to fund two Cardano sponsorship packages and related fees, taxes, and a 2027 deposit.

The proposed cost breakdown allocates ₳1,166,666.67 to Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, ₳833,333.33 to Rare Evo 2026 title sponsorship, and ₳750,000 to Intersect, audit, fees, tax withholdings, and a Dev Gov Day 2027 deposit.
Rare Network says it will return 20% of all VIP ticket sales to the Cardano Treasury, with the current VIP ticket retail price stated as $900.
The proposal states Rare Evo 2026 will occur regardless of treasury funding, but treasury funding would expand Cardano presence, accessibility, participation, and strategic outreach.

Rare Evo 2025 is reported to have had 2,500 attendees, 80 exhibitor booths, 85 speakers, 100+ ecosystem partners, 20K+ livestream views, 4M social media impressions, 40+ Cardano projects represented, and 50+ enterprise participants.

The first Cardano Dev Gov Day in 2025 is reported to have welcomed approximately 500 attendees and included workshops, panels, networking, governance discussions, technical education, and a Charles Hoskinson keynote.

The proposal says selected Cardano projects and contributors will use open application and qualification processes for speaking opportunities, booth space, volunteer roles, and travel or lodging assistance.
The proposal claims Rare Network has operated in the Cardano ecosystem since 2020 and has produced Rare Evo annually for five consecutive years.
The proposal includes external links to videos, a Google document report, and a social media livestream as supporting material for Rare Evo 2025 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2025.

The proposal states sponsorship inventory may change if another sponsor buys the mainstage or livestream package before the vote passes, in which case Cardano would receive a sponsorship of equal impact or dollar value.

summary: The document asks for ₳2.75M for Rare Network event sponsorships around Rare Evo 2026 and Cardano Dev Gov Day 2026, presenting historical event metrics, proposed sponsorship benefits, selection processes, and a partial cost breakdown, while leaving several treasury diligence questions unresolved.
